# gtm_v1_container_versions (Data Source)

Lists all Container Versions of a GTM Container.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The GTM Account ID.
- `container_id` (String) The GTM Container ID.

### Optional

- `headers` (Boolean) Retrieve headers only when true.
- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Also retrieve deleted (archived) versions when true.

### Read-Only

- `container_version_header_json` (String, Sensitive) All container version headers of a GTM Container.
- `container_version_json` (String, Sensitive) All versions of a GTM Container.
